title: Men and Women Vows

questions.question: If a man makes a vow to the Lord, can he break his word?
options: No, he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth
Yes, if he pays a fine
Yes, if he changes his mind
questions.correctAnswer: No, he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:2 (ESV): "He shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth."

questions.question: Who can nullify a young woman's vow living in her father's house?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:3-5 (ESV): "If her father hears of her vow... and disapproves... then none of her vows... shall stand."

questions.question: If her father hears and says nothing on the day he hears?
options: Then all her vows shall stand
questions.correctAnswer: Then all her vows shall stand
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:4 (ESV): "Then all her vows shall stand..."

questions.question: Who can nullify a wife's vow?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:6-8 (ESV): "And if she is married to a husband... and her husband hears of it... and disapproves... then he makes her vow... void."

questions.question: When must the husband disapprove for it to be void?
options: On the day he hears of it
questions.correctAnswer: On the day he hears of it
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:7-8 (ESV): "But if... on the day that he hears of it..."

questions.question: What about the vow of a widow or divorced woman?
options: Everything she has vowed stands against her
questions.correctAnswer: Everything she has vowed stands against her
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:9 (ESV): "But any vow of a widow or of a divorced woman... shall stand against her."

questions.question: If a husband nullifies them after he has heard (later on), what happens?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:15 (ESV): "But if he makes them null and void after he has heard of them, then he shall bear her iniquity."

questions.question: Why does the Lord forgive the woman in the case of a father/husband nullifying?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:5 (ESV): "And the Lord will forgive her, because her father opposed her."

questions.question: This chapter deals primarily with the validity of...?
Who did Moses speak to regarding these statute heads?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:1 (ESV): "Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes..."

questions.question: Is "binding oneself by a pledge" treated the same as a vow here?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:2 (ESV): "Vows a vow... or swears an oath to bind himself by a pledge..."

questions.question: If a woman vows in her father's house in her youth, who has authority?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:3 (ESV): "When a woman vows... in her father's house in her youth..."

questions.question: If the husband says nothing day after day?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:14 (ESV): "...then he establishes all her vows... because he said nothing to her..."

questions.question: What is the "thoughtless utterance" mentioned?
questions.explanation: Numbers 30:6 (ESV): "...or any thoughtless utterance of her lips..."

questions.question: Are there exceptions for men breaking vows?

key_verse_text: If a man vows a vow to the Lord, or swears an oath to bind himself by a pledge, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
